name: compunet-reborn-desktop
description: Compunet Reborn desktop client (Electron shell around the web client)

scripts._comment: ⚠ Every script that PACKAGES or RUNS the app rebuilds the web client first. The shell only copies ../web/dist/app.bundle.js, so without this an installer silently ships whatever bundle happened to be on disk — it builds fine, launches fine, and runs stale code. That shipped once: an installer went out carrying a bundle four commits old, and the symptom (an old behaviour persisting after a fix) looks like a bug in the fix.
